Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SITC of 01 twin-cell FRP cooling tower of 960 USGPM on a raised platform, with conden ser water piping, valves, control panel and cabling, and shifting of 02 existing condens er pumps, under buy-back of three old 125 TR cooling towers, with three (3) years com prehensive on-site warranty, at INCOIS, Hyderabad. Buy-back, testing, commissioning and warranty Clause: Removal and buy-back of the old cooling towers [BoQ item 18] a) Scope of Buy-Back (As-Is-Where-Is): Three old 125 TR cooling towers and their listed accessories are offered for buy-back on an "as is where is" basis with no warranty from INCOIS, b) Bidders must quote a single consolidated buy-back value excluding GST, alongside a per-tower brea kdown, as a separate field that cannot be deducted from any standard BoQ item line. c) INCOIS reserves the right to Exercise/Not Exercise Buy Back Option. However, the bidders must quot e separately as per Annexure VII-B and to be uploaded under financial document only, in which case t he contractor must still dismantle and stack the towers under BoQ Item 18 at no extra cost. d) Bidders should note that Buyback value will not be part in deciding L1. e) The old cooling towers must remain fully operational until the new tower passes its 72-hour continuo us trial run and is formally accepted in writing. f) Dismantling must be done using an approved crane lifting plan without damaging RC pedestals, whi le ensuring waterproofing restoration, pipe blanking, and complete removal and labelling of old fan fe eder cabling. g) All hazardous lubricants must be drained into leak-proof containers and handed over to a TGPCB-aut horized recycler, with mandatory submission of disposal manifests to INCOIS. h) Financial Adjustment: The buy-back transaction will be processed via recovery against works contra ct payments as a credit deduction in the contractor's tax invoice, or it will be unilaterally recovered by INCOIS from the Second Milestone Payment. i) All buy-back scrap must be cleared from the campus within seven days of handover using a valid m aterial gate pass to avoid storage charges. Warranty period: 3 years comprehensive on-site warranty from the date of acceptance, as per C lause 5.6: year 1 within items 1 to 19, years 2 and 3 under item 20. Payment terms: (a) Milestone 1: After Supply (70% Payment) 70% of the contract value for items 1 to 19 will be released within 30 days of the physical delivery of all m aterials at the INCOIS campus, Hyderabad. For items paid on joint measurement (Items 2 and 12 to 16), th is 70% progress payment will be calculated based on actual quantities delivered to the site. Payment will be processed against the submission of the following documents: a) Joint Receipt Inspection Report (JRIR) signed by both INCOIS and the contractor. b) Original Manufacturer (OEM) test certificates for major equipment (cooling tower components, mot ors, VFDs).

c. Factory Test Report for the control panel CP-01. d. d) Original ink-signed tax invoice. e. e) Proof of valid Transit, Storage, and Erection All-Risk Insurance policies. (b) Milestone 2: Final Payment After Installation, Commissioning & Handover (30% Payment minus Buy-Ba ck) The balance 30% of the contract value for items 1 to 19 will be released within 30 days of the satisfactory completion of the entire scope of work, including successful installation, testing, commissioning, performa nce check, 72-hour continuous trial run, and formal written acceptance by the Engineer-in-Charge. · Quantity Adjustments: Final payment for measurement-based items (Items 2 and 12 to 16) and approved variations will be reconciled and adjusted based on final joint measurements in this bill. · Buy-Back: If INCOIS exercises the buy-back option, the single consolidated buy-back value quoted by the contractor plus applicable GST must be shown as a clear, distinct credit deduction/discount item inside this final milestone tax invoice. If the contractor fails to incorporate this credit value, INCOIS shall unilaterally r ecover the entire buy-back amount plus applicable GST from the gross payable amount under this bill. The old towers shall only be dismantled and removed under BoQ Item 18 after the new system passes the 72-h our trial run and is accepted. · Prerequisite Documents: Payment is subject to the submission of the Final Acceptance Certificate, all h andover/as-built documentation (including PLC/VFD parameters, passwords, O&M manuals), and the submi ssion of a valid Performance Security (e-PBG/Bank Guarantee) as per Point 7. (c) Payout for Comprehensive On-Site Warranty (Item 20) The quoted annual rate for the 2nd and 3rd years of the Comprehensive On-Site Warranty under BoQ Item 20 will be paid on an annual, deferred basis at the end of each respective warranty year. Payouts are strict ly subject to the submission of satisfactory bi-annual preventive maintenance service reports signed by th e Engineer-in-Charge and the deduction of recoveries, if any, for delayed rectifications as per Clause 5.6. T he 1st year of the warranty is built into the capital costs of items 1 to 19 and carries no separate payout. Old Cooling Towers Offered for Buy-back Details of the old towers: The towers below are offered on “as is where is” basis. INCOIS gives no warranty on their condition. Bidder s shall satisfy themselves at the site visit. Sl. Tower Capacit Year Make / model / Sr Type Present conditi y . No. on 1 CT-1, Substatio 125 TR 2004 Paharpur FRP, induced draft, Not Working n terrace axial fan 2 CT-2, Substatio 125 TR 2004 Paharpur FRP, induced draft, Not Working n terrace axial fan 3 CT-3, Substatio 125 TR 2004 Paharpur FRP, induced draft, Not Working n terrace axial fan Included with each tower: fan, motor, drive, basin, MS support frame on the pedestals, local piping up to t he cut points fixed at the joint survey, and the old fan feeder cables.
